text:
sarah: Quick heads-up — we have the BYOK handoff for tenant `acme-42` scheduled Sat 02:00 UTC. Need to lock down RBAC changes and the incident handoff plan in case of an accidental rewrap. Who owns the temporary operator creds? sarah: Also: compliance asked for explicit audit retention and proof-of-handoff docs. omar: I can own the RBAC change. Plan: create a scoped role `byok-handoff-operator` with timeboxed expiry + MFA. :thumbsup: omar: Minimal patch idea: ```yaml
role: byok-handoff-operator
permissions:
  - kms:ImportKeyMaterial
  - kms:RewrapKey
  - kms:DescribeKey
conditions:
  - type: timebound
    expires: 2026-03-22T04:00:00Z
  - type: mfa_required
``` omar: We'll apply via infra pipeline and require two approvers (sec + eng lead). lucy: Audit retention — compliance wants 7 years for key custody events. Can we forward KMS/HSM audit stream to our SIEM and also snapshot the attestation logs to an immutable bucket? randal: Yes. We already have audit-forwarder in staging. Add filter: `eventType:KeyMaterialChange tenant:acme-42`. Forward to kafka -> siem and s3-immutable. randal: Example filter for the forwarder: ```json
{ "filter":"eventType=KeyMaterialChange AND tenant=acme-42", "destination":"kafka://audit-ingest, s3://redwood-immutable-logs/byok/" }
``` sarah: Good. What about on-call triage? If rewrap happens accidentally, we need immediate rollback plan and evidence capture for legal. omar: Triage play: 1) Quarantine tenant traffic to read-only 2) Snapshot current keystore 3) Pull the HSM attestation and KMS audit for last 24h 4) Rollback to previous key material (if escrow present) or escalate to customer contact. omar: I'll open an incident channel at the handoff time and ping oncall. lucy: Legal wants chain-of-custody doc with signed timestamps from both parties. Can we add signed webhook receipts to the handshake flow? randal: We can. Add a `handshake_receipt` step in the onboarding lambda that signs the timestamp with the operator ephemeral key and pushes to the immutable bucket. That becomes our PoE. randal: Pseudocode for receipt: ```python
receipt = sign(ephemeral_priv, f"tenant:acme-42|time:{ts}|action:handoff")
s3.put('s3://redwood-immutable-logs/byok/receipts/{ts}.sig', receipt)
``` infra-bot: [alert] rotation-service: detected pending BYOK rotation for tenant=acme-42 scheduled at 2026-03-22T02:00:00Z. sarah: Nice. Two more checks: 1) KMS integration — ensure `allowlist_source_ips` includes customer's proxy, 2) Ensure HSM operator consoles are audited (screen recording retention?). omar: For screen recordings — short answer: no, we capture session metadata + keystroke audit, not full video. Compliance accepted metadata + signed receipts last time. lucy: I'll create a checklist for the compliance packet: RBAC diff, audit-forward config, signed receipts, immutable bucket retention policy, handoff email template, oncall incident steps. sarah: Please also include a quick rollback decision matrix (if escrow key present vs not). lucy: Will do. Target: PR for RBAC + forwarder changes by EOD Fri. omar: I'll queue the infra PR and set reviewers to @sarah and @randal. sarah: Thanks — if anything looks risky we delay the handoff. :pray: randal: One more: ensure we set `replay_protection=true` on handshake protocol to avoid replayed import requests. sarah: Good call. Update the playbook accordingly. infra-bot: [info] infra-pipeline: RBAC patch dry-run started for branch `byok-handoff-4987654321`.
